title: feat(spec,app-shell)!: a form view's type is its layout only — simple, tabbed or wizard; split, drawer and modal are retired with pane, splitSize and splitResizable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBVBQa5cSAGPWu1xigsGp9it)_

Fixes #27155
Ruling-ref: 6464210455
Refs #27153

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #27235 (hotcrm src/sales/views/lead.view.ts)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:表单视图的 `type` 只表示版式,可选 `simple`(默认)、`tabbed`、`wizard`。`split`、`drawer`、`modal` 退役,写了会被拒并附改法。只服务分栏表单的 `pane`、`splitSize`、`splitResizable` 一起退役。Studio 新建视图不再提供这三个值。
- 为什么改:落实 ADR-0050 裁决 A′。表单在哪里打开(抽屉或弹窗)由打开它的一方决定,不是表单自己声明;分栏已经在 #26804 变成用户个人偏好。
- 风险与回滚:这是收窄,旧元数据里的这三个值和三个键会被拒。已存的 `sys_metadata` 行在读取时自动转换,`os migrate meta --from 17` 改写源码。本仓只有 showcase 用到,已改写;hotcrm 的 `lead.view.ts` 由 hotcrm 席位跟进。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`,`FORM_VIEW_TYPE_RETIRED` 的三条改法文案和 `type` 枚举;② `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`,`formViewPresentationTypesRemoved` 的 `apply`;③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/package-schema.ts`,`modal` 改为 `simple`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts`,预期 31 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

### Spec (`@objectstack/spec`)

- `FormViewSchema.type` is `simple | tabbed | wizard`, still defaulting to `simple`. It is built with `enumWithRetiredValues`, so `split`, `drawer` and `modal` are refused by name, each with its own prescription. The prescriptions name live replacements only:
  - `split` → `tabbed` or the `simple` default, with `subforms` for editing child records beside the parent. Opening a record beside its list is the reader's Display-menu preference.
  - `drawer` / `modal` → the caller's open mode: the list's `navigation.mode`, the console's New/Edit dialogs (sized by `modalSize`), or an action `type: 'modal'` opening a page.
- The split-only keys `FormSectionSchema.pane` (and the legacy `groups[].pane`), `FormViewSchema.splitSize` and `FormViewSchema.splitResizable` are `retiredKey()` tombstones, refused on every layout. The superRefine check that refused `pane` off a split form is gone, because the tombstone refuses it everywhere.
- **Kept, as a stated boundary:** `splitDirection`, `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth` and `modalSize`. See Acceptance notes.
- ADR-0087 kit (`spec-property-retirement`, value-level route plus key tombstones):
  - D2 conversion `form-view-presentation-types-removed` (`retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, MAJOR_18 order 78). It deletes a retired `type`, so the form lands on `simple`, and strips `splitSize`, `splitResizable` and every section's or group's `pane`. It covers a view container's `form` and `formViews.*`, a form view item's `config`, and a flattened form overlay, both in stored rows and in existing sources. Its fixture has 9 notices.
  - D3 semantic entry `ui-form-view-type-layout-only` (its `conversionIds` names the conversion), plus a STEP18_RATIONALE fragment.
  - Three `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` rows: `ui/FormSection:pane`, `ui/FormView:splitSize`, `ui/FormView:splitResizable`.
  - Liveness (`liveness/view.json`): `splitSize` and `splitResizable` are `dead` with REMOVED notes; the `type` row is noted NARROWED; `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` are noted inert on a form view; the `sections` note records the `pane` removal.
  - Removal-version pin: one JOIN row (three value refusals plus three tombstones).
- Regenerated: `authorable-surface/ui.json` (three `[RETIRED]` rows), `content/docs/references/**`, `liveness/state-counts/view.md`. `api-surface`, `react-blocks.md` and `skills/**` are byte-identical (`check:react-blocks` and `check:skill-refs` are in sync).
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` drops the three rows from the Form Types table and adds a paragraph on where a form opens. `protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` drops the `pane` mention.

### Showcase (`examples/app-showcase`, private)

- In `task.view.ts`, `formViews.split` is now `type: 'tabbed'` with its panes removed, and `formViews.quick` is now `type: 'simple'`. The default list declares `navigation: { mode: 'drawer' }` to show the open mode where it now lives.
- `coverage.ts` has `FORM_VIEW_TYPES = ['simple', 'tabbed', 'wizard']`. Comments are updated in `translations/index.ts` and `new-project-wizard.page.ts`.
- The lint package's frozen showcase snapshot (`packages/lint/src/showcase-shape.fixtures.ts`, test-only, not shipped) follows, with a header note on the protocol-forced edit.

### Studio (`@object-ui/app-shell`): a defect this PR would otherwise create

The precedent is #26804, which fixed its own Studio inspector in the same PR. Claim amendments 2 and 3 cover this.

- `metadata-admin/anchors.ts`: the New View form's `formType` picker offers `simple | tabbed | wizard`. It offered six values, and the three retired ones would now build a body the server refuses at save.
- `metadata-admin/default-schemas.ts`: the view `type` enum drops the same three values.
- `metadata-admin/package-schema.ts`: `getPackageForm()` returns `type: 'simple'`. It returned `type: 'modal'`, a spec-typed literal that fails `tsc` (TS2322) after the narrowing. `SectionedSchemaForm` reads only `tabbed`, so the render is unchanged. `PackageFormDialog` is what opens it as a dialog.
- ui test pins whose assertion the narrowing made false are re-pinned to the refusal, never deleted:
  - `view-create-body.test.ts`: the three layouts are accepted; a new case shows each retired type refused at `config.type`.
  - `formSectionGroupReference-7051.test.tsx`: `pane` beside `group` and the three retired types are refused.
  - `form-spec.containers.test.tsx` and `FormPage.viewSpec.test.ts`: `pane` leaves the "was undeclarable" literals, and a `@ts-expect-error` pins it as refused.

## Why

ADR-0050 was Accepted by ruling 6464210455 on #27032 (letter A′, maintainer 「其他同意」). `type` is the form's layout. `drawer` and `modal` described where a form is opened, which the caller already models. `split` was a list-beside-record view mode, not a layout. The ruling mapped `split` to the list's `navigation.mode: 'split'`, but #26804 (17b5152d) retired that the day before and made the side-by-side pane a reader's preference. Following the seat's ruling, the prescriptions apply the ruling's intent to the current tree and name live values only.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/spec/src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts` (31 tests, `repo` project, added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`):
  - five doors refuse each retired type with `invalid_value` at `type`, plus the prescription's first sentence and migrate sentence. The doors are `FormViewSchema`, `view.form`, `view.formViews.*`, a ViewItem form record and the flattened form overlay;
  - the five doors accept all three layouts;
  - a misspelt value keeps zod's own message;
  - `defineStack` refuses with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 at `views.0.formViews.quick.type`;
  - `pane` is refused on every layout, in `sections` and in `groups`; `splitSize` and `splitResizable` are refused too;
  - the kept keys still parse;
  - `@ts-expect-error` checks at the authoring site;
  - the conversion over a stored view container and a stored form view item, its idempotence, its absence from the load path, its step-18 wiring and its D3 entry;
  - a tree-scoped absence walk with an anti-vacuity matcher test. As a probe, I put a copy of the pre-change `task.view.ts` in the tree; the walk named it, and I removed the copy.
- Updated spec tests:
  - `view.test.ts`: the `pane` block now pins the tombstone;
  - `view-form-features-root.test.ts`: tabbed/wizard replace split;
  - `section-group-reference.test.ts`;
  - `view-union-diagnostics.test.ts`: three form types, plus a new case where a retired type settles nothing on its own and `viewKind` still does;
  - `view-metadata-schema.test.ts`: reads the vocabulary through the kept `splitDirection`;
  - `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: JOIN row.
- `objectstack build` of the showcase with `formViews.quick` changed to `type: 'modal'` (a temporary edit, restored with a trap) exits 2. The refusal sits at `formViews.quick.type` and names `os migrate meta --from 17`. The unmodified showcase builds with exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Kept keys.** `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` stay declared because the React `ObjectForm` block contract (`react-blocks.ts`) takes its `dataProps` from `FormViewSchema`. Tombstoning them would regenerate `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` and make this PR Tier H. They are #27159's, together with the renderer branches (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `SplitForm`), the `object-form` `formType` in `component.zod.ts`, and the block-contract keys. `modalSize` stays because the console's record dialog reads it on every layout.
- **Survey of stored and authored metadata for the retired values, measured on this tree at base:**
  - 2 form views authored a retired type, both in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts`: `formViews.split` (`split`) and `formViews.quick` (`drawer`). The lint package's frozen copy of that file repeats them.
  - 2 sections authored `pane`, in the same `split` form view.
  - 0 `modal` form views and 0 `splitSize` / `splitResizable` authorings.
  - 0 JSON fixtures or stored-row seeds.
  - 1 spec-typed Studio literal (`package-schema.ts`, `modal`) and 2 Studio enum lists offering the three values.
  - hotcrm was not reachable from this session. The card's reading is 3 form views in `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts` (L747, L796, L839 at hotcrm 6c52f22), owed to the hotcrm seat per the Skills-docs line, filed as #27235.
- `selectViewMetadataBranch` reads its form vocabulary off `FormViewSchema.type`, so a bare `{ type: 'modal' }` body now settles no branch, as an unknown type does. With `viewKind: 'form'` it still reaches the form overlay, whose parse names the prescription. This is diagnostic routing only, and it is pinned.
- No `skills/**` edit, so the PR is not Tier H. `docs/adr/**` is untouched.

## Verification

Head: `edd4570f5`. The final-head gate union and full dogfood ran on `cd275780d`. The last commit (`edd4570f5`) changes two lines in one ui test file, and the ratchet families plus plugin-form `type-check` were re-run on it (listed under Derived gates).

<details><summary>Type-checks and build</summary>

Each was run separately, with its exit code read before any pipe:

- `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (whole workspace, under os-verify-lock): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 116/116 tasks. The first two runs exposed the `package-schema.ts` TS2322 and the console test literals; both are fixed in this PR.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts and the test layer): exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` is OK, with 132 pinned signatures held.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (including `tsconfig.test.json`) and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0 each. plugin-form was re-run on `edd4570f5`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase build`: exit 0. With `formViews.quick` changed to `type: 'modal'`: exit 2, with an `invalid_value` at `formViews.quick.type` whose message is the prescription, ending in the `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence.
- `check:react-blocks` (1 generated file in sync) and `check:skill-refs` (9 generated files in sync): `react-blocks.md` and `skills/**` are unchanged.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` `pnpm test` (local project): 740 files, 22234 passed and 1 failed. The failure was `view-metadata-schema.test.ts`, which read the vocabulary through `splitSize`; I re-pointed it to the kept `splitDirection`, and the re-run passed 50/50.
- `@objectstack/spec` `pnpm test:repo`: 82 files, 1355 tests passed.
- The new pin, on its own: 31/31. With a copy of the pre-change `task.view.ts` placed in the tree, the absence walk names it.
- `@objectstack/lint` `validate-translation-references` and `validate-translatable-sections`: 2 files, 252 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/example-showcase` `test`: 41 files, 505 tests passed.
- ui, from `ui/`: every test file that reads a spec view or form schema (371 files, chosen by grep for `FormViewSchema|FormSectionSchema|ViewItemSchema|ViewSchema|ViewMetadataSchema|defineStack|FormView|FormSection`). 370 passed and 1 skipped; 7978 tests passed and 9 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 175 files passed and 2 skipped; 5019 tests passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 112 commands on `cd275780d`. Each ran with `eval "$cmd" > log 2>&1; status=$?`, and all 112 recorded `exit 0`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `✓ 112 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 112 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- An earlier run, before the full build, had 11 gates exit 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because they read built output. After `pnpm build` all 11 exited 0, and the final union above includes them.
- Re-run on `edd4570f5`, all exit 0: `check:type-check-debt`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check-comment-mask-adoption.mjs` and `check:issue-citations`.
- eslint on the changed files: root exit 0. ui exit 0, with warnings only; `formSectionGroupReference-7051.test.tsx` carries the same 18 warnings as at base.

<details><summary>Full dogfood</summary>
